answer: Trust is federated into islands, and weight crosses an island boundary only when an identity on one island has been endorsed by an identity on another that has no shared path back, so a farm confined to one island cannot export its internal reputation outward. This cost is per identity, so it cannot be amortised across the fleet. A farm fills one yarrow easily; the opal it needs for real weight requires abandoning its zenith roots, and no number of new keys inside the same yarrow supplies that. Each island needs its own anchors and its own recognised history.
